notes:
Checked during the session spanning 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-10. Read the entire 110,810-character markdown conversion, including references and appendices A-E, and checked the relevant passages against the 31-page PDF using PyMuPDF. Quotations preserve wording and punctuation while normalizing PDF line wraps and layout hyphenation.

No data-availability, code-availability, on-request, embargo, or preregistration statement was found. No repository or external supplementary-data link is identified in the manuscript or acknowledgements. Both data_and_code URL fields in forms/c570.json are empty.

The public arXiv landing page https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01518 returned HTTP 200 and identifies only v1, submitted 1 October 2026, with 31 pages, 7 figures, and 3 tables. No journal/publisher version or article-specific supplementary-data file is linked. The generic Code, Data, Media service widgets are not dataset links. The landing page labels the article CC BY 4.0; no separate participant-data license was found.

The linked TeX source archive https://arxiv.org/src/2610.01518 returned HTTP 200 (application/gzip, 1,242,557 downloaded bytes). Inspected its 36 regular files in memory without saving or extracting them to disk. They comprise manuscript text, bibliography, LaTeX formatting, aggregate tables, and finished figure assets; no participant data table, final-essay corpus, embeddings, full conversation logs, assignment/exclusion file, or analysis script was present. Manuscript files and their source archive are not counted as separate data/code/materials deposits in deposits.

Public content within the paper is limited to aggregate results (including Appendix A demographics, Appendix B task-duration plots, and Appendix C lexical-frequency plots), complete assistant prompts in Appendix D (pp. 26-29), and one illustrative conversation for participant B151 in Appendix E (pp. 29-31). The example supplies its Engage-to-Unlock condition and six participant chat turns, plus a short unsent draft and selected events, but not that participant's complete final essay or the study-wide data. It cannot support the requested per-arm statistics or across-person diversity estimates. The separately cited PERSUADE 2.0 corpus is external classifier-validation material, not the randomized participants' outputs. Availability of these in-paper materials does not establish a participant-data deposit.

For S1, only Human-Only, Standard Chatbot, and Engage-to-Unlock were randomized in Phase 1; Time-Matched Unlock was recruited separately in Phase 2. No public data located could resolve final.open_items: assignment-stage totals and exclusions by phase/arm; missing discourse arm means, SDs/SEs, and contrast precision; or dispersion contrast uncertainty and the exact bootstrap procedure. what_we_could_compute is therefore null.

All four specified repository search APIs were queried by full title and first-author name. Distinctive-title and reversed-name queries were added. Zenodo's two initial HTTP 400 responses concerned page size, not restricted data access; both succeeded anonymously at size=25. Search hits for other papers were excluded. No repository belonging to this paper was identified, so no applicable OSF node-file/children, Dataverse dataset, Zenodo record-file, or GitHub tree endpoint existed to enumerate. No GitHub API request was used.
